headers: Uses terminologies of business with clarity for the purpose of effective communication in and control of the business.

entries.competence: Uses terminologies of business with clarity for the purpose of effective communication in and control of the business.
entries.period: Guide students to explain the meaning of journal. Guide students to define and discuss the types of Journal and their uses. Lead students to explain the relationship of the general journal to the ledger. Guidance question to be solved by the students. By using examples prior to show journal entries common business transactions. To guide students through examples prepared prior posting information from the journal to t he ledger account.
entries.teaching_act: Listening. Writing the main point discussed. To participate fully on discussing regarding to the type of uses and function of the journal. Asking questions if any. Attempting solving problem. Listing. Observing on how example are being drafted prepared. To participate fully on asked question. Writing down the main point. Asking questions if any.
entries.learning_act: Flow chart showing steps of journalisation. Diary. Charts showing the format of the journal entries.

entries.main_topic: Introduction Suspense account and statement of correcting net profit. Introdu ction to non- profit making organization.
entries.period: Leading discussion to define error. Guide students to mention errors which affect trial balance and errors which do not affect trial balance. Lead students to define suspense account. Recording transactions to suspense account. Use the above examples to correct the net profit. Lead students to use journal to correct the errors. Guide students to define non profit making organization. Lead students to define receipt and payments amount. State the importance of receipt and payment account. Lead students by prepared example to prepare statement of affair. Income and expenditure. Receipt and payment. Balance sheet. Subscription account.
entries.teaching_act: To discuss and reach conclusion or meaning of connection of error. To mention errors which do not affect trial balance and errors which affect trial balance. To define suspense account. To use journal to record the transactions which lastly reach conclusion of suspense account. To show suspense A/C Lastly use the example above to correct net profit. To define non profit making organization. To define receipt and payment account. To mention advantages and disadvantages of receipt and payment. To define terms used in non profit making organization like: Income and expenditure. Receipt and payment. Subscription. Balance sheet. Lead students to solve the examples given.
entries.references: Record the transactions given in the suspense account. Asking questions about non profit making organization.

entries.competence: Demonstrate the ability to control Debtors and creditors and effective communication in the business.
entries.objective: Students should be able to use terminologies with clarity for the purpose of effective communication and control business.
entries.sub_topic: Introduction to control account Purchases/Creditors ledger and Debtors control account
entries.teaching_act: Lead students by prepared question to record sales ledger control account and purchases ledger control. Identification of adjustment and its effect.
entries.learning_act: To use the question given to solve together with teacher. To adjust the control account.
entries.assessment: Given class work which can be solved by all.

headers: Demonstrate ability to find profit or loss from statement in the business.

entries.competence: Students should be able to use terminologies of A/C with clarity for the purpose kof effective communication in and control of business.
entries.main_topic: Introductions to incomplete records. General financial statement.
entries.period: Guide students to define incomplete records. Lead students to compute business bank and cash balance from incomplete records. Prepare final accounts from incomplete records. Guide students to prepare profit and loss A/C and balance sheet. Guide students to define financial statement. Lead discussion on general purposes of financial statement. To describe income statement and preparation of that account. To lead students to prepare balance sheet.
entries.teaching_act: Listening. Writing down main points. Full participatory in finding the bank balance and cash balance. Asking questions if any. Through illustration questions prepared final account. Writing down the hints. To participate fully on discussion to give general statement. Asking questions if any.
entries.learning_act: Flow chart showing the records of the business that does not keep the records properly. Posters showing common format of financial statement.
entries.references: Student should be able to solve the question given in the class. Pupils should be able to prepare financial statement.

entries.objective: Understand the budget and able to classify the different types of budget.
entries.sub_topic: Introduction to government budgeting procedure. Revenue estimates and procedure.
entries.teaching_act: To guide students to define budget. Guide students to state steps in preparation of budget. Explain purpose of central government budgeting. Lead students to arrive the meaning of Surplus budget. Deficit budget. Balance budget. State the objectives of financial budget.
entries.learning_act: Listening. To state steps in preparation of budget. To explain the purpose of central government. Writing main points. Participating fully on discussion. Asking questions if any.
entries.references: Governm ent acco unt hand out.
entries.assessment: Asking students the types of budget. Balance budget. Fixed budget. Zero budget.
